scripts.push: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ] || [ "$RENDER" = "true" ]; then if [ "$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_SCHEMA_PUSH" = "true" ]; then drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts; else echo "Skipping automatic production schema push. Use reviewed migrations; set ALLOW_PRODUCTION_SCHEMA_PUSH=true only for an explicitly reviewed maintenance window."; fi; else drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts; fi
